changed.title: Three quadratic parity relations let each selector offset use a single cubic product, and four can prevent it
changed.statement:
∀ k : ℕ,
  let F := ZMod 2
  let S := Fin k → F
  let quad := fun (f : S → F) => ∃ (b : F) (l : S) (M : Fin k → Fin k → F),
    ∀ s, f s = b + dotProduct l s + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * s i * s j
  let rel := fun (E : Finset S) => E.powerset.filter (fun U => @decide
    (∀ f : S → F, quad f → (∑ s ∈ U, f s) = 0) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let triple := fun (a b c s : S) => dotProduct a s * dotProduct b s * dotProduct c s
  let sig := fun (U : Finset S) (a b c : S) => ∑ s ∈ U, triple a b c s
  let fit := fun (E : Finset S) (h : S → F) (a b : S) =>
    ∃ (c : S) (f : S → F), quad f ∧ ∀ s ∈ E, h s = f s + triple a b c s
  (∀ (E : Finset S) (h : S → F),
    let odd := (rel E).filter (fun U => (∑ s ∈ U, h s) = 1)
    let forms := odd.image sig
    (∀ a b : S, fit E h a b ↔ ∀ U ∈ odd, ∃ c : S, sig U a b c = 1) ∧
    ((rel E).card ≤ 8 ∨ (forms.card ≤ 4 ∧ ∀ U ∈ odd, ∃ a b c : S, sig U a b c = 1) →
      let pairs := (Finset.univ : Finset (S × S)).filter
        (fun v => @decide (fit E h v.1 v.2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
      3 * 2^(2*k) ≤ 32 * pairs.card)) ∧
  (5 ≤ k → ∃ (E : Finset S) (h : S → F), (rel E).card = 16 ∧
    ∀ a b : S, ¬ fit E h a b)

changed.context: Dualize the third-factor map at the prescribed syndrome. A zero form gives four independent affine cuts among the relations. At most four odd forms need survive. changed.title: Eight graph-corner tests recover the attainable edge errors of one extra nonlinear gate
changed.statement:
∀ k : ℕ,
  let n := k+1
  let F := ZMod 2
  let S := Fin k → F
  let V := Fin (k+1) → F
  let e := fun (i j : Fin k) => if j = i then (1 : F) else 0
  let bits := fun (x : V) => List.ofFn (fun i => decide (x i = 1))
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let legal := fun (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2*n) C ∧
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
      (g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or ∨ g.op = .mod 2 ∨ (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1))) ∧
    C.gates.countP (fun g => @decide
      ((g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _)) ≤ n+1
  let err := fun (C : Circ) (y : V) (b : F) =>
    (∑ x : V, if C.eval (bits x ++ bits y) = decide (dotProduct x y+b = 1)
      then (0 : ℝ) else 1) / Fintype.card V
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (Z : Fin N → S), 0 < N →
    (∀ (a : S) (b : F), a ≠ 0 →
      N ≤ 4*((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter (fun j => dotProduct a (Z j) ≠ b)).card) →
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (u v : Fin m → Fin k) (label : Fin m → F), (∀ i, u i ≠ v i) →
      let loss := fun (C : Circ) (i : Fin m) =>
        4*(∑ j, err C (Fin.cons 0 (Z j)) 0) / N +
        ∑ t : F, ∑ r : F, ∑ s : F, err C (Fin.cons t (r • e (u i) + s • e (v i))) (t*r*s*label i)
      let bad := fun (p : S × S) (i : Fin m) =>
        if p.1 (u i)*p.2 (v i) + p.1 (v i)*p.2 (u i) = label i then (0 : ℝ) else 1
      (∀ C : Circ, legal C → ∃ w : S × S → ℝ,
        (∀ p, 0 ≤ w p) ∧ (∑ p, w p) = 1 ∧ ∀ i, (∑ p, w p * bad p i) ≤ loss C i) ∧
      ∀ p : S × S, ∃ C : Circ, legal C ∧ ∀ i, loss C i = bad p i

changed.title: Local cut potentials certify weighted error lower bounds for one-layer circuits on interval observations
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
    xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
        (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (Q.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun h => ds.getD h 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD Q.output 0
∀ (n m a t E : ℕ) (T : Fin n → Fin m → Bool)
  (row : Fin n → Option (Fin a)) (bags : ℕ → Finset (Fin m))
  (u : Fin n) (q : Fin m) (_ : row u = none) (w : Fin n × Fin m → ℕ),
  (∀ i j k : Fin a, i ≤ j → j ≤ k → bags i.val ∩ bags k.val ⊆ bags j.val) →
  let cut := fun j : ℕ => if 0 < j ∧ j < a then bags (j-1) ∩ bags j else ∅
  let R := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun x => row x = none)
  let rows := fun i : Fin a => R ∪ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => row x = some i)
  let entry := fun x y => ((T x y).toNat : ZMod 2)
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun x y => entry x y + entry x q + entry u y + entry u q
  let rk := fun (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2)) (I : Finset (Fin n)) (J : Finset (Fin m)) =>
    Matrix.rank (B.submatrix (fun x : I => x.val) (fun y : J => y.val))
  let X := Fin m → (ZMod 2)
  let State := Submodule (ZMod 2) X
  let supported := fun (S : Finset (Fin m)) (z : X) => ∀ y ∉ S, z y = 0
  let agrees := fun (i : Fin a) (U V : State) =>
    ∀ z : X, supported (cut i.val ∩ cut (i.val+1)) z → (z ∈ U ↔ z ∈ V)
  let fits := fun (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2)) (i : Fin a) (j : ℕ) (U : State) =>
    (∀ z ∈ U, supported (cut j) z ∧ ∀ x ∈ rows i, B.mulVec z x = 0) ∧
    rk A R Finset.univ + rk B (rows i) (bags i.val) + (cut j).card ≤
      2*t + rk A R (bags i.val) + rk B (rows i) (cut j) + Module.finrank (ZMod 2) U
  let cells := fun i : Fin a => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin m)).filter
    (fun z => row z.1 = some i ∧ z.2 ∈ bags i.val ∧ z.2 ≠ q)
  ((∀ (P : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    (∀ g ∈ Q.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) Q →
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents P Q → depth (n+m) Q ≤ 1 → Q.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t →
    (∀ x y, row x = none → P x y = T x y) → (∀ x, P x q = T x q) →
    E ≤ ∑ i : Fin a, ((cells i).filter (fun z => P z.1 z.2 ≠ T z.1 z.2)).sum w) ↔
    2*t < rk A R Finset.univ ∨ ∃ h : ℕ → State → ℕ, h 0 ⊥ = 0 ∧ E ≤ h a ⊥ ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin a) (U V : State) (F : Finset (Fin n × Fin m)), F ⊆ cells i →
        let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun x y => A x y + (if (x,y) ∈ F then 1 else 0)
        agrees i U V → fits B i i.val U → fits B i (i.val+1) V →
          h (i.val+1) V ≤ h i.val U + F.sum w)

∀ n m : Nat, 3 ≤ n → 3 ≤ m →
  let good := fun A : Fin n → Fin m → Bool =>
    let lr := fun i k : Fin n => ∀ j, A i j = true → A k j = true
    let lc := fun j l : Fin m => ∀ i, A i j = true → A i l = true
    Function.Injective A ∧ Function.Injective (fun j i => A i j) ∧

    ∃ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)), ∀ i j, A i j = B (e i) (f j)
  let count := if min n m < 4 then 0 else if n = m then (if n = 4 then 1 else 2)

    (∀ i, good (family i)) ∧ (∀ i j, iso (family i) (family j) → i = j) ∧
    (∀ A, good A → ∃ i, iso A (family i))
